newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka passes 12,500T sugar tender, to retender.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka passes 12,500T sugar tender, to retender.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state buying arm, the Co-operative Wholesale Establishment, has passed on a tender for 12,500 tonnes of white refined sugar and reinvited bids, traders said on Thursday.
"The CWE today asked suppliers to renew bids till Friday," a trader said.
It was not clear why the state buying arm is holding a fresh tender for the purchase, which is for delivery in Colombo in the first half of December.
